limits: `played` means the chime was queued on the audio thread, not that anybody heard it: a chime carries no utterance id, so there is no `voice.utterance` report to wait for. The `voice.route` events after this call are the route it took
the system default device and the system volume are never touched (§7): the chime goes to the deck's own output UID at the operator's `set speaker` gain
